name: claude-skills
description: Personal Claude Code plugins: Azure DevOps, Go, Swift (concurrency + modern features), and git worktree workflows.

plugins.name: ado
plugins.description: Azure DevOps operations - PRs, pipelines, policies, builds, variable groups, environments, feeds, branches, work items, comments.

plugins.name: swift-concurrency
plugins.description: Diagnose data races, implement actor isolation, resolve Sendable issues, fix @Observable + @MainActor interaction problems, and guide Swift 6 migration.

plugins.name: go-dev
plugins.description: Go development with toolchain-first verification workflow -- writing, testing, debugging, profiling, and dependency management.

plugins.name: modern-swift
plugins.description: Swift language features beyond concurrency: attributes (@available, @discardableResult, @frozen, @inlinable, @backDeployed, @resultBuilder, @propertyWrapper) and macro usage (#Preview, custom macros).

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Batch-provision git worktrees for planned work across multiple repos, plus status/lookup/teardown slash commands.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Flag house-style violations in written prose and in commit messages: em dashes, non-ASCII bytes in PowerShell files, buzzwords, and filler phrases.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub's remote MCP server, limited to documentation search and the read-only security toolsets: code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot alerts, and security advisories. Authenticates with the gh CLI keyring token.
